label: Third-factor moral-access explanation…: A proposed explanation linking selected-for normative…
definition: A proposed explanation linking selected-for normative judgments and normative truth through independently valued survival: causal evolutionary influence on belief together with a noncausal normative/constitutive connection. Survival is only qualifiedly good, not good because selected. The reply relies on a suitable belief–action mechanism, reasonably good starting points and reasoning; it does not claim causal influence of basic normative truths or full counterfactual robustness.
